description: This file defines the FilterValidator class which implements validation logic for filter fields in SuiteCRM's JSON API filters module. It includes a method isValid() that verifies the input is a string and potentially enforces specific filtering rules.

classes.name: FilterValidator
classes.description: Validator class that checks whether a filter field key is a valid string according to predefined rules for SuiteCRM's JSON API filters.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided fieldKey is a string; throws InvalidArgumentException if not.
